target.role: Already-inspected five-stock development target, never untouched holdout

license.status: Public author-published teaching data for local research inspection; no blanket right to redistribute or republish CRSP raw data established. University site and Wiley excerpt retain copyright; no license is inferred from anonymous HTTP access.

sampling_limits: Author-selected five teaching examples, not random or a representative firm panel. Large and long-lived listed firms are overrepresented; sector, size and survivorship selection cannot be estimated from five series.
Different start dates, all ending 2008-12-31, unlike the 2000-2025 French training target. Calendar overlap is not a new held-out target.

No population snapshot, firm-entry/exit coverage, underlying quotes/dividends, permanent IDs or independent audit of adjustments. Provider return convention accepted from primary-source chapter, not reconstructed.
Series and descriptive statistics are now inspected development data. They must never later be described as unseen evaluation data.

target.window_rule: Latest first date and earliest last date across the preselected five files. Require identical observed trading-date lists in that interval; no deletion, imputation or winsorization.
target.return_definition: Decimal simple daily total returns including dividends, per Tsay Chapter 1 section 1.2.5 and Table 1.2; original second-column values, no extra dividends or adjustment
target.observation_operator: Compute all nine moments separately for each company, then take the equal-company mean; never compute moments of a pooled series or a stock basket

bootstrap.method: Circular time-block resampling with the same date index for all five stocks, preserving same-day cross-company dependence; conditional on these selected firms. Only descriptive scaling, no confidence/acceptance test.

fixed_support_constraint.derivation: D>=0 gives r_total>=exp(-c)-1; |log(P[t]/V[t])|<=g gives D/P[t-1]<=(yield/252)*exp(g+c). Bound applies to days satisfying the model guard, and is deliberately loose.
fixed_support_constraint.interpretation: Fixed-cap model cannot reproduce these four observations. This is a support mismatch, not a proof that nine summary moments cannot be approximately matched.
